claim_text: A reservation for a sports hall must be submitted at least three working days in advance.

gold_evidence.quote: A reservation shall be submitted in writing or electronically at least three working days before the desired hour.

annotator_notes: Paraphrase of Art. 2(1).

claim_text: Students under 18 years of age pay half the fee.

gold_evidence.quote: For students under 18 years of age the fee is reduced by 50 per cent.

annotator_notes: Paraphrase: 50% reduction means half the fee.

claim_text: The fee for using the halls is BGN 35 per hour.

gold_evidence.quote: The fee for use is BGN 25 per hour.

annotator_notes: Changed amount: 35 instead of 25 BGN.

claim_text: A single user may reserve up to six hours per week.

gold_evidence.quote: A single user may reserve no more than four hours per week.

annotator_notes: Changed threshold: six instead of four hours.

claim_text: The sports halls are open every day from 8:00 to 22:00.
annotator_notes: Opening hours are not specified in the passage.

claim_text: The agreed price for the roof repair is BGN 12,000 including VAT.

gold_evidence.quote: The agreed price was BGN 12,000 including VAT

annotator_notes: Near-verbatim fact.

claim_text: The client paid an advance of BGN 4,000 by bank transfer.

gold_evidence.quote: Mr Kolev transferred an advance of BGN 4,000 to the company's bank account

annotator_notes: Paraphrase.

claim_text: The repair was completed before the agreed deadline.

gold_evidence.quote: the deadline for completion of the works was 31 May 2024
The repair was completed on 20 June 2024

annotator_notes: Requires comparing two sentences: 20 June is after 31 May.

claim_text: The remaining balance was paid by bank transfer.

gold_evidence.quote: the remaining balance of BGN 8,000 was paid in cash against a receipt on the same day

annotator_notes: Payment was in cash, not by bank transfer.

claim_text: The roof inspection was carried out two weeks after the written complaint was sent.

gold_evidence.quote: On 8 July 2024 he sent a written complaint to the company
Today, 22 July 2024

annotator_notes: Multi-document: complaint on 8 July (P2), inspection on 22 July (P4), 14 days.

claim_text: According to the expert, the leak is caused by the cracked plaster on the chimney.

gold_evidence.quote: The plaster on the chimney has surface cracks but shows no signs of water penetration.
According to the expert, the leak in the attic is caused by the unsealed membrane joint and the cracked tiles.

annotator_notes: The claim repeats the company's position from P2, which the P4 inspection report contradicts.

claim_text: The company manager signed the inspection report.

gold_evidence.quote: Nikolay Stoyanov refused to sign the report.

annotator_notes: Requires linking the name to the manager role (P2 and P4).

claim_text: The estimated cost of eliminating the defects is BGN 1,800.

gold_evidence.quote: The estimated cost of the repair to eliminate the defects is BGN 1,800.

annotator_notes: Near-verbatim fact.

claim_text: The company repaired the leaks on 30 July 2024.
annotator_notes: Neither P2 nor P4 contain information about the leaks being repaired.

claim_text: The contract provides for a five-year warranty on the roofing works.
annotator_notes: No warranty period is mentioned.

claim_text: The company received the complaint on 10 July 2024.
annotator_notes: The passage states only the date of sending (8 July), not the date of receipt.

claim_text: The penalty under Art. 4 was adopted by a municipal council decision of 14 February 2023.
annotator_notes: The passage does not state when or by whom the rules were adopted.

claim_text: The rules enter into force on 1 January 2025.
annotator_notes: No effective date is stated.

claim_text: The irrevocably fixed conversion rate of the German mark to the euro is 1.95583.

annotator_notes: Exact rate from Article 1.

claim_text: The conversion rate of the Italian lira to the euro is 1,936.27.

gold_evidence.quote: 1  936,27 Italian lire

annotator_notes: Exact rate from Article 1.

claim_text: The regulation sets the conversion rate of the Spanish peseta to the euro at 170.386.

claim_text: Greece is among the eleven Member States adopting the euro from 1 January 1999.
